# CINDER — LLMs System Context & Navigation Map

> CINDER is an intelligent, agent-facilitated social coordination platform that transforms how attendees discover, meet, communicate, and participate in conferences.
> Architecture: Joyzoning Sovereign Architecture (DOMAIN, CORE, INFRASTRUCTURE, PLUMBING, UI). Zero external npm dependencies.
> Retrieval: Elasticsearch Hybrid Search (BM25 keyword + 32-dim dense vector kNN cosine similarity + Reciprocal Rank Fusion).

## Quick Reference
- Root Directory: /Users/bozoegg/Desktop/elasticsearch
- Package Name: cinder-conference (v1.0.0, Node ESM)
- Entry Points:
  - CLI Router: bin/cinder.mjs
  - Demo Scenario: bin/demo.mjs
  - HTTP Server: bin/server.mjs
  - Composition Root: src/core/CinderApp.mjs
- Test Runner: node --test tests/*.test.mjs
- Architecture Check: node /Users/bozoegg/Desktop/HEAV3NS-JOY/bin/joy-check.mjs .
